title: Austin Addresses Drivers, Mobility, Green Policy
summary:
Here’s a summary of the Austin City Council meeting:

*   **Chauffeur Permits to Get Appeals Process:** Following emotional testimony from professional drivers facing job loss due to new background check rules, the Council showed strong support for creating an appeals process to address these "unintended consequences."
*   **Transportation Bond Implementation Begins:** Initial steps for the city's major mobility bond package were approved, with commitments for extensive public input on project prioritization, equity considerations for housing and businesses, and developer coordination.
*   **Methane Emissions Targeted:** Austin reinforced its climate protection efforts by endorsing federal measures to reduce potent methane emissions from oil and gas operations.
*   **Development & Affordability Scrutiny:** Public discussion on the large "Grove" development emphasized the need for fair infrastructure cost-sharing between developers and taxpayers, and a focus on generating deeply affordable housing.

agenda_items.description: BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN:  The City Manager is directed to identify and return to Council a recommendation on how to fund off-site sidewalk and traffic calming improvements associated with the Grove PUD in an amount not to exceed $900,000.

agenda_items.description: Approve a resolution authorizing the City Manager to fund a pilot program for employer-assisted housing (related to the Grove PUD).   Resolves: The City Council authorizes the City Manager to provide funding to support a pilot program that will connect housing and jobs through local employers by matching income-qualified local employees with on-site affordable units and the employer paying the differential between employee income (approximately 40% MFI) and affordable units at the Grove (approximately 60% MFI). The funding authorized by this Resolution must be provided to a program that includes an evaluation of the programÃ¢â‚¬â„¢s impact on employee retention, satisfaction, and other similar factors that are related to program goals.

The City Manager is directed to work with the Austin Police Department and with community partners as appropriate to immediately prepare and distribute gun safety brochures at community festivals, neighborhood association and community meetings, and other public events. These brochures should address the safe handling and storing of firearms as well as offer suggestions for how to discuss these matters with others.  The City Manager shall schedule an event to give away free gun locks and educational brochures and shall also make these resources available to the public at neighborhood association and community meetings as well as events and festivals
Approve a resolution supporting the Environmental Protection Agency's work toward finalizing methane pollution standards.

Approve a resolution directing the City Manager to identify emergency funding for immigrant legal services. City Council directs the City Manager to work with City departments to identify emergency funding for immigrant legal services and outreach with a goal of assisting with the cases of 100 additional Austinites per month than are currently being served, for the remainder of FY16-17. City Council directs the City Manager to bring back recommendations for Council action or budget amendments by the January 26, 2017 Council Meeting, and to strongly consider expanding existing contracts that could best perform these services as soon as possible.

Posting language:  Approve an ordinance amending City Code Chapter 13-2 relating to ground transportation driver disqualification.  The ordinance, which has updated verbiage, allows for ATD to review denied/disqualified cases of individuals seeking chauffeur permits.  The ordinance is set to go into effect immediately.   There was additional direction that the City Manager to bring back options for having the appeals process involve Municipal Court...City Manager must also come back with other recommended processes, as staff deems appropriate.
